30|User paused the task

31|The user paused the task via POST /api/tasks/{id}/control, action=pause. This Planner/Worker run was actively canceled; running intents return to frontier(open), to be reclaimed and restarted from the beginning after task resume
32|Orchestrator Agent paused the task
33|The orchestrator Agent called pause_task to pause this task. This Planner/Worker run was actively canceled; running intents return to frontier(open) and restart after resume
34|Task deleted
35|The task is being deleted (DELETE /api/tasks/{id}); the deletion barrier canceled its running Planner, Workers and main Agent. This run's results will no longer be used
36|Backend restored the task's paused state
37|At startup the backend restored the persisted paused task state. This run was canceled; normally no Agent is running during recovery
38|Planner determined that task goals were met

40|Task-timeout wrap-up wait exhausted

41|After task timeout, running Workers were allowed to wrap up gracefully, but the 90-second drain grace expired, triggering hard cancellation. Intents are marked exhausted; facts and assets already written during wrap-up are retained
44|Planner terminated this intent
45|The planner called kill_work to terminate this intent, usually because it was off-track or no longer useful. The intent is marked stopped and will not be automatically reclaimed
46|User paused this Worker intent
47|The user paused a running Worker. This call was canceled and the intent becomes paused; registered intents, facts, findings and activities are retained. It restarts from the beginning after resume
48|User deleted this Worker intent

49|The user deleted a running Worker. This call was canceled; after the Worker leaves the write region, the server applies the selected deletion mode: soft deletion marks it deleted and retains all output, while hard deletion cascades to the intent and downstream nodes supported only by it
50|Worker finished normally and released its context
51|The Worker finished normally; the engine releases context resources in detachWork. This is not an interruption; if shown as one, cancellation raced with finalization events
52|New run rejected while task is paused
53|The engine refuses new execution contexts while the task is paused, preventing a claim/pause race from starting a Worker. Claimed intents return to the frontier
56|User stopped this conversation turn
57|The user clicked Stop to abort this main Agent or conversation Agent run. Existing activities are retained; another message can be sent
58|Task pause also stopped the main Agent conversation
59|When the user paused the task, its running main Agent conversation was canceled too. Existing activities are retained; this message will not automatically replay after task resume
60|Conversation turn finished normally and released its context
61|This conversation turn finished normally; the server is releasing its context resources. This is not an interruption; if shown as one, cancellation raced with finalization events
64|Backend process is shutting down
65|The backend received SIGINT or SIGTERM and is restarting, updating or shutting down. All running Agents are canceled; after restart, leftover running intents reset to open and execute again
